title: com.read_ack arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0098)
description: Exactly one of three forms: one message (DEC-0073's), up to 100 named messages, or one thread up to a named message of it. A bulk call is all or nothing: a message the reader cannot read refuses the whole call (not_authorized), and marking again changes nothing. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here.

message.description: A message of a thread the caller's Project takes part in; an absent and a foreign message answer the same not_authorized.

oneOf.title: A thread up to a message

upTo.description: A message of that thread: every message of the thread delivered to the reader at or before it is marked, the oldest 1000 at most (the receipt says more).
